    {"id": "...", "score": ...},

  ]
}

EPREL-1576176: energy 0.645, water 9.0, noise 42, duration 255

IDX-NEFF-S189ECX0ME: energy 0.54, water 9.0, noise 38, duration 295

Next: EPREL-1586891 (0.54), IDX-AEG-GU8200A2SNW (0.54), IDX-BOSCH-SMS6YCW15E (0.54), IDX-NEFF-S189ECX0ME (0.54) (four with 0.54)
Next: EPREL-1576176 (0.645)
Next: EPREL-2253240 (0.747)
Next: EPREL-1405065 (0.95)

EPREL-1586891: 8.4
IDX-AEG-GU8200A2SNW: 8.4
IDX-BOSCH-SMS6YCW15E: 9.0
IDX-NEFF-S189ECX0ME: 9.0

Now between IDX-BOSCH and IDX-NEFF both water 9.0, compare noise: BOSCH 40, NEFF 38 => NEFF better (lower noise). So order: IDX-NEFF, then IDX-BOSCH.

Thus 0.54 group order: IDX-AEG, EPREL-1586891, IDX-NEFF, IDX-BOSCH.

Now continue ranking after that group: EPREL-1576176 (0.645), EPREL-2253240 (0.747), EPREL-1405065 (0.95).
